text: According to classical sense-data theory (Russell, Moore, Price, Ayer), the immediate objects of perceptual awareness are:
choices: Sensorimotor contingencies that the perceiver has mastered
Nothing at all - perception is a bare relation with no object
Mind-dependent entities ('sense-data') bearing exactly the qualities experience presents
explanation: Sense-data theory holds that the immediate objects of awareness are mind-dependent sense-data bearing exactly the qualities experience presents (the oval look of a tilted coin), with physical objects only inferred as their cause. Option 0 is direct realism, option 1 is enactivism, and option 2 is closer to adverbialism; only the last states the sense-datum view.
